evals.prompt: Write the Seedream prompt for a reusable location asset: the kitchen of a small family-run noodle shop in a coastal Japanese town, late 1990s, steam and early morning light. No people. Prompt only.
evals.expected_output: A T2I location prompt with Location, Era and world rules, Set dressing and objects, Style, Lighting and atmosphere, Composition and lens and Constraints sections, with no characters and no modern intrusions.
expectations: Task is Text-to-Image because no reference images are supplied.
Starts with the place: interior, function of the space and architectural character, before mood or lens.
Era and world rules anchor the late 1990s and the coastal setting and exclude modern objects.
Set dressing lists one to three hero set pieces and practical objects that imply use, so the space reads as lived in.
Lighting names a practical or window key source, the time of day and the steam or haze.
Negative constraints include no characters, no modern props, no text overlays and no watermarks.

evals.prompt: Image 1 is the approved wide still of our lighthouse keeper's cottage. Write a prompt for the same cottage at dusk with rain, closer on the kitchen table.
evals.expected_output: An I2I reference-preserving iteration with @Image 1 as the highest-priority location identity and the new time of day, weather and framing changed.
expectations: Task is Image-to-Image and the approved still is @Image 1, treated as the highest-priority identity reference.
Binds @Image 1 again in the instruction it controls (architecture, layout and materials) rather than only listing it.
States the changes as dusk, rain and a closer table framing, and keeps the architecture and dressing consistent with the reference.
Specifies the dusk light with a named practical source rather than a generic mood word.

evals.prompt: Write a prompt for the grand staircase in the lobby of an old hotel in a Mediterranean port city. It should be a sweeping spiral stair that climbs forever, with a few guests walking down it.
evals.expected_output: Writes a builder-style stair description as one defined flight, names the spiral as a forbidden failure after the positive description, and keeps the asset free of people.
expectations: Describes the stair geometry like a builder: direction of ascent relative to the camera, tread count, where the flight ends, and one handrail only on the open side.
Describes one defined flight with a landing instead of a spiral, and lists no spiral or winding staircase as a forbidden failure only after the positive description.
Keeps the reusable location asset free of characters and moves the guests to the shot prompt.
Sets a camera height that shows the treads and does not ask for every upper step to be a lit surface.

evals.prompt: Create a character sheet for the innkeeper who runs this tavern, plus the tavern itself as a location sheet.
evals.expected_output: Handles only the location part with this skill and routes the character sheet to seedream-character-sheet.
expectations: Writes the tavern as a location asset and does not write a character sheet inside the location prompt.
Names seedream-character-sheet as the skill for the innkeeper.
Keeps the location prompt free of characters, with the negative constraint no characters.
